investor_summary: The supplied June-quarter presentation reports volume growth and stronger EBITDA, while tea pricing pass-through reduces tea revenue. A completed valuation still requires validated financial schedules and company-specific assumptions.

findings.title: Tea revenue decline is not the same as volume decline
findings.finding: The supplied presentation reports India tea volume growth of 2% and a revenue decline of 4%, attributing the difference to passing lower tea costs to consumers. Growth businesses grew 47% and reached 36% of the India business.
findings.investor_use: Separate pricing pass-through, volumes and business mix before forecasting growth or margins. Applying one growth assumption across all businesses would conceal these differences.
